dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hah! Hiromi's still as much of an idiot as ever!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But seriously, though, the war's over, ain't it? When's this Sakoku Decree going to be abolished, eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "C'mon, old man Okazaki, you've got ways and means, don'cha? Come on, give me the scoop..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "What am I gonna do with that Sakoku scoop, you might ask? Well, I'll come right back to Ritou to settle down, and I'll run a legit business, of course!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: Please be patient, dear customer. I believe that the days will get better.

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: Ah, by the way. Hiromi left a letter and a gift again. I will safeguard them for you for the time being.
